previous_reviews.prompt: Classify the ACTUAL exercise from motion and equipment across all frames. Compare the direction of the handles relative to the torso. A seated LAT PULLDOWN has a cable or handle ABOVE the head, pulled DOWN toward the upper chest; elbows move from overhead down beside the torso and return up. A MACHINE CHEST PRESS pushes handles FORWARD from chest height and returns, not from above the head. REVERSE PEC DECK opens the arms BACKWARDS with the chest facing its pad; the elbows do not cycle overhead. A SHOULDER PRESS pushes a weight UP from shoulder height to overhead. PULL-UP moves the BODY toward a fixed bar rather than pulling a handle down to a stationary seated torso. Use visible apparatus and movement, not the color of clothing or background text. Imperfect technique stays the same exercise. Setup, rest, unsupported action or uncertain evidence is 0. Only choose one code from the provided list; no explanation.
